purpose: Test whether changing Kv1p5 availability away from the cue sources improves two-task response separation while junction permeability remains impaired.
scientific_risk_addressed: At 0.9x coupling, background correction leaves four known joint cases unresolved; target recalibration leaves five. Separate physical response separation from reader refitting, background correction and direct amplification of the cue-source channel population.

alternative_control.mask: Apply to membrane patches whose zero-based cell_owner plus one is in cell_ids; all cue-source patches remain unchanged.
alternative_control.meaning: Static scaling of maximal permeability on the selected patches. Gate kinetics, initial m/h values and cue-time fractional inhibition remain fixed. This is not an adaptive controller.
alternative_control.bounds_rationale: A bounded symmetric 10% local pilot, not an empirically measured biological range.
alternative_control.dose_caveat: Per-source fractional inhibition, patch areas, cue-source maximal permeability and pulse timing are unchanged. Network feedback can still change voltages and actual ionic currents; integrated transported charge is not constrained to match.

calibration.reader: Reuse the nearest-calibrated-polyline reader and the existing calibration_geometry implementation. Fit each condition separately for this geometric diagnostic only.
calibration.selection_inputs: Only calibration responses; do not load, simulate or rank the inspected evaluation cohort as new evidence.
calibration.objective: Half the minimum opposite-label fitted-curve distance, including segment interiors and endpoints, minimized across joint tasks, relevant single-task arms and all three timesteps on selected320. Comparators and null controls do not enter ranking.
calibration.selection: Require all numerical/domain/null-control checks, a unique winner on each backend, CPU/L4 score agreement within 1e-15 V, improvement over sham beyond that tolerance on both backends, and a minimum above 2 nV on both. Retain sham for ties or disagreement. Report every candidate, including valid negative results and invalid failures.
calibration.distinct_reader_views: Retain the raw frozen source reader, shared-no-cue-reference assistance, and condition-calibrated geometry separately. A gain in the geometric objective does not establish unassisted transfer or overwrite the preceding transfer failures.
calibration.no_recovery_claim: This pilot can select a candidate for confirmation. Fitted calibration curves are not continuous-response bounds, fresh-strength outcomes, empirical noise tolerance or biological recovery.

controls.reference: Reuse authenticated unperturbed calibration histories from the passing pulse-confirmation study.
controls.impairment_only: Reuse the completed lower-coupling calibration subset, after the whole source run is authenticated.
controls.sham: Run channel scale 1.0 at coupling scale 0.9 through the same intervention path. All full histories must reproduce archived lower-coupling calibration histories bitwise. This is a numerical control, not an independent biological replicate.
controls.nulls: Run no-cue and disconnected arms for every condition. Even disconnected remote histories can change under a local channel intervention; do not require them to equal the unimpaired channel case.
controls.shared_initial_state: All candidates start from the same archived initial state. Only initial states must match historical lower-coupling candidates with different channel availability; post-start histories can differ immediately.
controls.failed_candidates: Keep complete durable inputs, finished windows, task outcomes and failure artifacts; no replacement candidate or silent retry.

verification: Before execution, bind the source completion and evidence manifest and authenticate frozen sources. A completed-condition diagnosis is insufficient to accept the whole source campaign.

Verify every input against its paired lower-coupling calibration input: only permitted channel patches differ; junction impairment, source patches, cues, initial states, geometry, solver and observations remain fixed.
Use the qualified bounded windowed runner and unchanged conservation/domain checks, CPU/L4 tolerances, three timesteps and full 14-array state archives.
Check bitwise sham history reproduction, common initial states, restart, reordered/partitioned worlds, and candidate-control isolation without imposing false post-start historical equality.
Keep calibration-only loading and geometry checks. Report each task, null controls, geometry, background drift and all reader views independently.
Retain GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage and per-arm kernel/archive times. Equal planned world-step budgets do not imply equal measured runtimes.

execution.remaining: Bind the completed coupling study and adapt the existing windowed qualification harness; this file and the input builder do not launch a run.
execution.estimate_basis: 540 worlds/backend versus the preceding 660-world 4 h 33 min confirmation; source authentication, archive I/O and per-condition setup can change this estimate.

followup: Freeze any selected setting before a separate fresh-strength confirmation. Recovery across other initial states, intervention after impairment, robustness, assembly-mediated replacement and autonomous adaptation remain later questions.
scope: One static synthetic bioelectric fixture and existing 512-us horizon. No new native BETSE parity, general polycomputing, heredity, biological replication or multi-GPU scaling claim.
